task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for ADP-06 at src/design/adp-06-pipeline-run-correlation.md. Define additive schema semantics for a nullable audit.pipeline_run_id UUID column and event metadata propagation of pipeline_run_id for pipeline-driven actions while preserving existing audit/event behavior for non-pipeline actions. Specify data-flow contracts for sourcing and threading pipeline_run_id through API/engine/event emission boundaries, queryability requirements across audit and events, migration/backfill nullability rules, indexing and lookup considerations, and compatibility constraints with OBS-03 and ES-08. Include concrete testability notes for correlation write/read behavior and non-pipeline null behavior. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines additive ADP-06 schema and metadata semantics with backward-compatible null behavior
Pipeline-driven audit and event write-path propagation rules for pipeline_run_id are explicit and consistent
Cross-surface queryability requirements for pipeline_run_id across audit and events are concrete and testable
Migration/index/nullability behavior is specified with compatibility constraints for existing records
Design includes traceability to OBS-03, ES-08, and ADP-09 with actionable testability guidance

result.summary: Design artefact for ADP-06 pipeline run correlation with additive nullable audit pipeline_run_id semantics, explicit event metadata propagation rules for pipeline-driven actions, backward-compatible null behavior for non-pipeline actions, cross-surface queryability/indexing guidance, and testability coverage linked to OBS-03, ES-08, and ADP-09.
